text:
Aisha: Tiny schedule tweak 1: the all-hands will start 5 minutes early at 15:55 PT to keep us on the hour. Please join the prep room 10m before if you're presenting.
Marco: Joining early. Quick Q: will the session be live-streamed and recorded as usual? Last time the live drop killed the recording.
Aisha: We're doing both live + recording. Ops added an atomic commit so recording persists even if the streaming edge fails.
Liz: Thanks. Any special instructions for demos with local audio devices?
Evan: Yes 1 if you use USB mics/headsets, message @Sam here so Ops maps the device to the recorder. Also avoid "Share computer sound" in the slide app. It duplicates channels and causes sync issues.
RecordingBot: recorder: set persistence_mode=atomic for group=all-hands. OK (2.1s)
OpsBot: preflight check: recorder-0 OK, recorder-1 OK, network jitter <5ms, disk space 68%
Sam: I'll be in the prep room to test inputs. If you have a demo that plays local audio, we recommend using the DeckAudio channel we provisioned.
Marco: Can we add a 7-min live Q&A after roadmap? People keep asking about model prioritization.
Aisha: Adding 7-min Q&A after roadmap. If we run out, we9ll collect remaining Qs here and send answers later.
Liz: Mic test: Liz here 1 says "redwood all-hands audio check"
Sam: Loud and clear.
Evan: If the stream buffers, try restarting the recorder container soft: `kubectl -n recorder rollout restart deploy/recorder` and ping #eng-sre.
Aisha: One more ops note 1 presenters: if you9re screen-sharing slides with embedded video, flag it here so we coordinate a transient higher-bitrate stream.
Marco: Noted - my demo has a short video clip. I'll flag it and join prep.
Aisha: Perfect. Thanks all. Drop urgent leadership Qs below and I9ll surface them during the live Q&A. See you shortly :raised_hands:
